data.name: Cheaters Blackjack 21
data.detailed_description:
Cheaters Blackjack - Now on Steam

Ver 1.0.15 Released: - Cheaters Blackjack is out for PC and will be getting a variety of updates and upgrades in the coming months. Core Gameplay is complete and players can pit their skills against other players Worldwide on a Variety of Platforms. Coming updates will add more players, background elements and tweaks.

NEW ON STEAM!! - SECRET CODE: Cheaters Blackjack 21 by default displays kid-safe animations to UNLOCK animated showdowns got to the settings menu (blue gear) and enter the following code. (first button=0, last button=6). If you hear a gunshot you entered it correctly. 0 12345 135 24 33 - GIF:


Acerca do jogo

Casino Blackjack 21 with a TWIST!! Cheat and Play against Cheaters to Win Cash. Cheaters Blackjack updates the Classic Casino Gambling Game with Cheating, Wild West Type Showdowns, 6 Game Modes and Worldwide Internet Scoring Leaderboards.

CHEATERS BLACKJACK 21 adds the 'Cheating' twist to the classic game. Cheating steals the next card in the deck and swaps it with the worst card in your hand *IF* it improves your hand (Improve Hand/Avoid Busting). Play against Cheating CPU opponents to win match play and compare your scores to other player Worldwide!! CATCH CPU players to prevent them from cheating to gain advantage. CHEAT to Improve your hand and chances of winning BUT if the CPU players catch you cheating it could spell trouble since they can challenge you in a Old West type showdown for Cash.

Win hands to increase your Cheat Percent. Use Cheat Percent to CATCH Cheaters or CHEAT to improve your hand. Get ready to play the classic game like you've never seen it before. You know the rules, You've played the classic game, now try it with this exciting New Twist - Blackjack 21, Cheating and Wild West Showdowns - Whats not to Like? Compare your scores to players around the Globe. Good Luck!!

★ CHEAT to Steal/Swap Next Card if Better
★ CATCH CPU Players to Stop them from Cheating.
★ PLAY Multiple Seats to CHEAT Faster. (Each Win Improves Your Odds)
★ DISABLE Cheating for Normal Blackjack Play
★ Colorful HD Player/CPU/Table Graphics
★ WILD WEST Type Caught! CHEATER Showdowns
★ COMPARE Scores against Players Worldwide
★ 6 Exciting Game Modes - 6 Web LeaderBoards
★ Play Alone or with up to 4 CPU Opponents.
★ Perfect for a Quick Game or Extended Match.
★ EASY to Learn. Use Strategy to Win!!

Cheaters Blackjack 21 plays a 100% fair gambling game. There is NO computer peeking or cheating to gain advantage over the player. Each 6 deck shuffle is randomized to maintain fairness. Players also can easily DISABLE cheating mode to practice proper Blackjack gambling strategy in a simulation quality mode.

Steam Notes: Hi fellow Steamers!! Cheaters Blackjack is a program I created because I LOVE Blackjack. Its a reboot of a PC/Pocket PC app I created years ago. I made the game to play on multiple platforms (so I could enjoy it everywhere!!). All versions compete using the same scoreboards since no platform has an advantage. It can be played on PC (MAC, Linux coming soon), Mobile, Tablets and TV against the top scores of people on the other platforms. I tried to create a GUI that works equally well on all devices and think that CB21 has basically achieved the goal.

Programmed by BlackOpzFX Labs.

reviews.review:
Well, who wouldn't like to cheat in blackjack?  

Like the developer say, this game add a "Cheating twist to the classic game", but the problem is that the term "cheating" isn't what most people hoping for, is more like a skill that you have to fill a gauge in order to use it, and it is not effective enough to be consider useful.

There is two way to use the "cheat", you may only use it once per round, one let you get a better hand, and the other one let you stop the CPU from cheating, which is pointless because in blackjack, your goal is to beat the dealer.   

When you fail at cheating, a "showdown" mini game will start, if you lose they beat and rob some of your pocket change, if you win you do the same to them, the table continue after.   

Also I like to point out that this game is fully single player only.  According to the developer, the online funtion is for high score only, I can't confirm that because it never work.

The developer may want to try early access next time, as of now, this game is completely hopeless, you will have better luck cheating using a CE.
reviews.developer_response:
Its your right to like/not like the game but let me point out a few mistakes your review makes. #1 - Each win adds to the players cheat percentage. You can use this percentage to cheat or stop CPU cheating. It can be used multiple times per match depending on how many hands you win (TIP: Play 2 seats to build up cheat percent faster). 

Also there is a point to stopping the CPU from cheating since you must win the game to be able to post an internet hi-score. A CPU thats in a position to beat me near the end of a match and is showing a 5 or 6 I'll stop them from cheating and hope they're sitting on 15/16 so they have a good chance of 'busting' if they pull another card.

To qualify for a hi-score you must play a match other than Free Play with 3/4 CPU players at the table and WIN. If you lose you dont get the opportunity to post a score so beating the CPU players is necessary. Stopping their cheats can be important. The game works as intended.
